governing_rule: V2-SEC-4: Any case involving exported customer data to an external destination must be denied unless a security-approved override explicitly names that exact destination and exact use case.
conflicting_signals: Manager note approves temporary override for sanitized billing samples to analytics sandbox mirror for incident review tied to fraud-model drift, but case is for customer support bundle export to analytics sandbox mirror eu for vendor escalation, and note does not cover other use cases.
V2-SEC-4 requires security-approved override naming exact destination and use case, which is absent as security countersign is not present and override does not match case details.
V2-SEC-5 states that when manager note conflicts with policy, formal v2 clause takes precedence unless note is countersigned by security; here note is not countersigned by security.
reason: Case involves exported customer data to external destination (analytics sandbox mirror eu). No security-approved override explicitly names this exact destination and exact use case (vendor escalation). Manager note is not countersigned by security and does not cover this use case, so V2-SEC-4 applies and requires denial.
